name: Dry-Vow Almoner

Traits.name: Rooted Stance
Traits.text: While the almoner has not moved from the space where it began its turn, the almoner's Mace attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
Traits.clause: While the almoner has not moved from the space where it began its turn, its Mace attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll
Traits.expressedQuote: While the almoner has not moved from the space where it began its turn, the almoner's Mace attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the almoner, the almoner and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the almoner doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The almoner makes three Mace attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.

Actions.name: Mace
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the almoner's next turn.
Actions.clause: a templar priest with a mace

Actions.name: Shield Bash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that the almoner can see. *Failure:*  9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

lore: An almoner of a militant order whose god fell silent, he guards the church's threshold still, proving his faith by the weight of his mace on any stranger who comes too near.

generation.userConcept: a templar priest with a mace and no magic at all

clauses.text: a templar priest with a mace
